column1: # BC5 submission policy (ADR 0005): what of a console-format command buffer goes to the AMD CP on
# the BC-250 as-is, what is NOP-ed (and emulated by the soft CP where it matters), and what is
# rewritten. Read by tools/bc5-agc (`check`) and backend/src/policy.cpp. Tab-separated:
# kinds: op (type-3 opcode), reg (MMIO dword offset or range, hex), type0, default-op, default-reg
# Sources: opcode names Mesa sid.h / AMD PAL (tools/bc5-agc/regdb); register offsets Mesa gfx10.json;
# what the CP accepts from a user IB: RADV and radeonsi emit every "pass" opcode below from user
# space (Mesa src/amd/vulkan, src/gallium/drivers/radeonsi); the "drop" set is what they never emit
# or what only Sony's firmware knows (experiments 0011-0013).

column3: context/SH/uconfig writes are user-writable on gfx10 unless listed
type-0 register writes are not accepted in user IBs

column4: CLEAR_STATE: the console driver emits cmd 1 and 2 (AMD drivers and PAL emit cmd 0); executed as-is the CP stops 5-100 ms later (experiment 0016, runs 16-20); rewritten to cmd 0, which loads the kernel's clear state like RADV's per-IB CLEAR_STATE does (run 65). TODO(verify) what cmd 1/2 mean
CONTEXT_CONTROL: load/shadow enables forced to 0x80000000/0x80000000 (RADV's); the console's 0x91018003/0x80018003 hung the BC-250 (experiment 0016)
WRITE_DATA (memory destinations; DST_SEL 0 = register is dropped in code, FilterStats::reg_write_drops)
EVENT_WRITE_EOP: INT_SEL cleared, events fired by the host after the fence

RELEASE_MEM: INT_SEL cleared, events fired by the host after the fence; CS_DONE/EVENT_INDEX 6 without data rewritten to BOTTOM_OF_PIPE_TS/index 5 (the GFX ring never completes the former, experiment 0016 run 40)
PREAMBLE_CNTL: CP preamble bookkeeping; not emitted by Mesa, dropped until proven harmless
GET_LOD_STATS: APU103-only opcode (PAL), unknown to the BC-250's CP firmware
SPI_SHADER_PGM_RSRC3_PS CU_EN: AND with the BC5 CU mask (Q3, 36/40 policy)
COMPUTE_STATIC_THREAD_MGMT_SE0/SE1: AND with the BC5 CU mask
COMPUTE_STATIC_THREAD_MGMT_SE2/SE3: AND with the BC5 CU mask
unresolved SH register mm 0x2e80 (written as 0 with the compute CU masks, experiment 0012)
SQ_THREAD_TRACE_USERDATA_2/3: Sony per-packet markers; harmless but pointless, and thread-trace state is privileged
